answer_1.quote: In this paper, we further bridge the gap between text and music by leveraging the power of NLP techniques to generate music conditioned on textual input.
answer_1.outputs: music audio conditioned on text descriptions

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we deploy the widely adopted Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) to assess the fidelity of the generated music distribution in comparison to the real music distribution...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a listener test with three perceivers (annotators) with diverse demographic backgrounds...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are instructed to categorize each music sample into one of four genres, judge which sample is real vs. generated, and rate generated music on fidelity, musicality, melody, harmony, and audio clarity.
